response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT f.feesnode, f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, f.rebrate, f.feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), base AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS b FROM m), g AS (SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / feerate) AS avg_relative_gap FROM m GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relative_gap, g.avg_rebate - base.b AS excess_over_baseline FROM g CROSS JOIN base WHERE g.avg_rebate > base.b ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC LIMIT 10
